in_sanskrit.name: गिरिधर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गिरि (giri) - mountain, धर (dhari) - to hold. So, Giridhari is one who holds the mountain.

in_hindi.name: गिरिधर
in_hindi.long_meaning: गिरि (giri) - गिरींदर (girindar) - mountain, धर (dhari) - धारणा (dharnaa) - to hold. So, Giridhari is the one who holds the mountain.

in_tamil.name: கிரிதர
in_tamil.long_meaning: கிரி (kiri) - மலை (malai) - mountain, அர் (ar) - அல்லவாலர் (allavar) - one who holds. So, Giridhari is the one who holds the mountain.

in_telugu.name: గిరిధరి
in_telugu.long_meaning: గిరి (giri) - గిరిపొయ్యము (giripoyyamu) - mountain, ధరి (dhari) - ధేశ్వర్ (dheshvar) - lord, master, controller. So, Giridhari is the lord or master who holds the mountain.

in_marathi.name: Giridhari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Giridhari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Giridhari is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Giri’ meaning mountain and ‘Dhari’ meaning holder. It is a revered name for Lord Vishnu, who holds the mountain Meru on his chest.

in_bengali.name: Giridhari
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Mountains
in_bengali.long_meaning: Giridhari একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Giridhari is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Giri’ meaning mountain and ‘Dhari’ meaning holder. It is a revered name for Lord Vishnu, who holds the mountain Meru on his chest.
